name: codex-page-workflow-state-owner
title: Codex page workflow state owner closeout
description: Finish the page workflow state owner so discover/open/read/write/submit/verify drives routing, recovery, completion, and stop-loss without prompt-hint fallbacks.
creator: yudi
notes: This workstream consumes the canonical connector payload contract from WS4 and closes the remaining page-progress and stop-loss seams. 2026-04-21 progress update: page intents now project explicit `page_workflow_progress`, recovery decisions/partial exits carry `page_workflow` snapshots, and turn diagnostics/turn events expose `active_page_workflow` instead of leaving stop-loss to prompt-only hints. 2026-04-21 closeout update: no-progress page recovery inside the legacy tool loop now freezes the narrowed tool subset and projects pending workflow progress back into `_runtime_intent_plan` instead of appending an ad-hoc recovery hint, contract-breach intent completion now prefers explicit page workflow progress over stale snapshot matches, and user-visible partial output reads page workflow phase/goal so unfinished page turns stop collapsing into generic text-only stop-loss lines.
